# M1 policy status overrides / notes. Format: <ID> <STATUS|=> ;; note
GOV-006 = ;; The core policy is stated in CLAUDE.md and capability-selection.md (string semantics are product behaviour; collation changes are product decisions). Open related item: UNCERTAIN-M1-0001 — capability-selection.md declares the SQL Server default collation (case-insensitive, accent-sensitive) as a technology default rather than an approved product semantic; whether this silently fixes observable comparison semantics when SPECIFICATION.md is silent is LINK_UNCERTAIN (see ORPHAN_SWEEP_REPORT.md).
RUN-021 = ;; Matched by performance.md and the caching skill. Open related item: UNCERTAIN-M1-0002 — the caching skill allows invalidating before the mutation is known to have succeeded when the workflow deliberately accepts that behaviour; whether that is a permitted exception to RUN-021 or a contradiction is LINK_UNCERTAIN.
GOV-015 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Git boundary and git-workflow. Open related item: UNCERTAIN-M1-0003 — git-workflow permits destructive Git operations when "clearly required by an approved workflow", which may widen the "explicitly requested" condition; LINK_UNCERTAIN.
API-019 = ;; Modality caveat: api.md states the liveness clause as "must not depend" (stronger than the oracle's "should normally avoid"); the health-check skill keeps the softer "usually avoids" wording.
WF-006 = ;; Modality caveat: verify and development-workflow state the smoke-verification obligation with MUST strength (oracle DEFAULT).
WF-010 = ;; Enforcement note: read-only review is enforced by disallowing Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit for the code-reviewer agent; shell tools are not disallowed, so read-only behaviour for shell commands rests on the instruction text.
DEP-025 = ;; Enforcement note: prohibition stated in add-dependency and enforced by the PreToolUse gate; M1 adds an explicit exception (EXTRA): force/legacy-peer-deps flags are allowed when the command line carries '# peer-override: approved-by-user' after explicit user approval.
DEP-003 = ;; Enforcement note: workflow and enforcement match; the manifest check is stricter than the oracle for floating versions (errors with no explicit-request exception, EXTRA) while range specifiers (^, ~, [..]) are not flagged.
FE-008 = ;; Matched; the frontend facet adds a stricter companion (no class-based interceptors without a reason).
ARC-020 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Decision Control Reserved list; M1 adds further Reserved categories (reference-graph changes, search/external storage/identity infrastructure, major libraries, versioning, project-wide conventions) recorded as EXTRA.
GOV-017 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md § Decision Control defines Decided/Delegated/Reserved classes, the Reserved minimum list ('at least'), the classification test, Decision Requests and headless handling (oracle-linked); M1 adds that an explicit user instruction counting as approval must be recorded through architecture-decision, plus further Reserved categories (EXTRA).
GOV-018 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md requires identifying and raising material concerns about a questionable request (duplication, cohesion, loading, context cost, conflicts, complexity) and proposing an alternative before implementing.
